candidate: VOLUME_RQA_ENTR_OVER_LMAX_RATIO_SHOCK_MR (RQA ratio ENTR/L_max, diagonal-line Shannon entropy normalized by max diagonal line length, on delay-embedded log-volume returns; m=2,tau=1,eps=0.5*std(r_window),W_RR=168,l_min=2; fade RATIO_ENTR_LMAX shocks vs ALB=336)
feature_definition: RATIO_ENTR_LMAX = ENTR / L_max. ENTR = Shannon entropy (natural log) over qualifying diagonal-line length distribution (k!=0, main diagonal excluded, l>=l_min=2), p(l)=n(l)/N. L_max = max length of qualifying diagonal lines (k!=0, main diagonal excluded, l>=l_min). Delay embedding m=2 tau=1 over trailing window W_RR=168, L-inf recurrence with eps=EPS_SCALE*std(window); causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if L_max<=0, no qualifying diagonal lines, ENTR undefined/non-finite, offdiag/recurrence degenerate, or undefined.
